name: Unscrupulous Loan
text: Limit 1 per investigator. Cannot leave play. [reaction] After you play Unscrupulous Loan: Gain 10 resources. Forced - When the game ends or you are eliminated, if you have fewer than 10 resources in your resource pool: Exile Unscrupulous Loan.
text_cn: 每位调查员限制1张。不能离场。 [reaction]在你打出大肆借贷后：获得10资源。 强制 - 在游戏结束或你退场时，如果你的资源池中的资源少于10：放逐大肆借贷。
